name: wand
about: Boss Rush: the wizard's wand (2026-11-23): an original slim tapered shaft of black lacquer with dark chrome rings, a grip wrapped with glowing cyan lines, a faceted chrome pommel and a clear faceted crystal tip. Tripo H3.1 (standard) from concept wand-a-sd-0 (Seedream; two other designs not used). Its own model, held in the wizard's right hand; the tip's light is the game's (a glow drawn at the anchor, charged before a cast).
